evidence: Wallet area label and changes to coin selection logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/spend.h.
rationale: Fixes a spurious 'insufficient funds' failure when `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse` is active. Output groups failing eligibility checks were added to `discarded_groups` twice and double-subtracted from available funds during automatic coin selection; the issue affects non-default configurations under specific conditions like mempool chain limits.
